k4a.gr: Felix Kagr signed the papers with a steady hand. The trench at R-F12 took him in like it takes everyone: without a word.
Felix Kagr answered the first call, number 4 on the rolls. Somebody chalked the number on his helmet. It has not washed off yet.
The Concord flag went up over Verdel Ridge. Felix Kagr did not cheer. He sat down on a sandbag and ate his ration slowly, like a man with time again.
Felix Kagr lent Bastian "Lucky" Vpy a pencil. It came back wrapped in a scrap of paper that said 'One good turn'.
rotrek_rock: Nobody asked Anselm "Parson" Rock why he came. Nobody in R-F9 asks that. He was handed a spade before he was handed a rifle.
Anselm "Parson" Rock was in the first hundred. The old hands in R-F9 call them 'the early birds', and not always kindly.
Anselm "Parson" Rock reported for duty as a sniper. The new kit was heavier than the explanation of how to use it.
A football came over the parapet from the Concord side with Anselm "Parson" Rock's name scratched on it. Gustav "Tin" Jul kicked it back. It did not come again.

Otto Commanderchr and Anselm "Parson" Rock divided a parcel using the lid of a tin as scales. The final crumb required a second opinion. News that the Concord had taken Verdel Ridge reached Anselm "Parson" Rock during supper. The same stew suddenly tasted better.
Anselm "Parson" Rock tried to write home with gloves on. The address is readable. Everything else will need some imagination.
